name: Chained head
description: A Soldier's head-plate packed solid and swung on a cord. Heavy, ridged, and about as far from subtle as this arsenal gets. Base runs deep timber brown — the packed, unfired thing. Its geometry is load-bearing: the weapon code scales this sprite by `ballR / 14`, so the 28px canvas and ~13.5 body radius must stay as they are.

evolved.description: The evolved head: the same packing, fired amber and bone. Brighter than the base along the whole ramp — a wrecking swing has to read as a different weapon from the ball it grew out of, at the size a projectile actually gets on screen.
